summary.text: Tim Nelson is the Libertarian candidate for the Oregon State Senate, District 13, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Courtney Neron (D/Working Families Party) and Glenn Lancaster (R). He works as a chef.

paragraphs.text: Nelson was the Libertarian candidate for Oregon House District 26 in 2018, receiving 2.0 percent of the vote, and again in 2020, receiving 2.3 percent; Courtney Neron (D) won both races.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, Nelson said both Democrats and Republicans work for donors rather than voters, and he named limiting the size, scope and cost of government as his policy focus.
His listed campaign messages were that taxes are theft and that all gun laws are unconstitutional.
